question: The Make in India Scheme of the Government is administered under the _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Commerce and Industry**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Make in India scheme is administered by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry**
 
• Launched by: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi on September 25, 2014**
 
• **Goal: T**o promote India as a global manufacturing destination
 
• Focus areas: New processes, new infrastructure, new sectors, and new mindset
 
• Achievements: **India has emerged as a global growth oasis**
 
• **The Make in India initiative is a collaboration between the central government, state governments, and various ministries and departments.**
 
• The central government formulates schemes, programs, and policies, while the states have their own schemes to attract investments. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of External Affairs**

 
 
• This ministry offers services like the Tatkaal Passport Service, which allows applicants to receive their passports faster than the regular process.
 
• The ministry also offers the Know India Programme (KIP), which aims to strengthen the connection between Indian diaspora youth and their ancestral homeland. 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Finance**
 
 
• The current Finance Minister of India is Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman. 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology**
 
 
• This ministry is committed to fostering transparency, accountability, and fairness in AI practices.
